correctness.rationale: For exactly k=F_(7^3) and the fixed rational BKS octic, direct point equation testing and an independent cubic-field pair-cross-product census are finite exhaustive proofs. Independently recomputed all 343^2 affine candidates: 365 curve points including infinity; all 66,430 pairs yield 49,945 >=2-secant lines; completed line histogram (48048,20000,46032,3528,21,28,336) at sizes (0,1,2,3,4,5,8), and secant-concurrence histogram (51633,19152,46872,336) at s=(0,1,2,8). Exactly 29 curve points are uncovered and 336 lie on eight secants, so 51604 uncovered points are exterior; no exterior triple concurrence. Independent enumerator and both included source implementations use exact field arithmetic, not sampling, and finite claim scope is precisely GF343.
